cleansingStrength.counterSignal: see rationale (counter-signals recorded there; convention value unchanged by claims, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system - prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@8 - with light routes (three hydrolyzed proteins @5, @7, @9; Glycerin@6). No silicone, payload lipid or pearlizing route, so C2 is not met. Counter-signal: strong ALS chassis and only one cationic; low is the neighbor.

excluded: Betula Alba Leaf Extract@14, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate@15, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder@16 (botanicals/ferment, no deposition role)
